messages:
Sasha: quick question for people-ops — the office rotation next week puts me on a desk next to the coffee machine. i've had recurrent vestibular episodes and the foot traffic/noise there makes symptoms worse. can we request a fixed seat as an accommodation?

Riley: saw you step out a couple times yesterday. def support.

Morgan (People Ops): thanks for flagging, Sasha. sorry to hear it's been rough. we can start an interim accommodation right away while doing the intake. do you want a temporary hold or a permanent desk request?

Sasha: temporary hold to start is perfect — at least through the current review window (about 6 weeks). i prefer a corner desk with low foot traffic, anywhere on floors 2-4 west wing.

Dana (Manager): i'll block rotation for Sasha immediately. Sasha, any desk number you particularly prefer? i can put in the Facilities hold.

Sasha: desk 2W-07 is great if available. otherwise 4W-02 would work.

Facilities Bot: Desk inventory check: 2W-07 currently free, 4W-02 occupied. Requesting hold requires manager approval. Link: https://internal-booking.company/desks

Morgan (People Ops): proposed steps: 1) Dana to place hold on 2W-07 for Sasha through 2026-06-15, 2) People Ops will DM Sasha the short accommodation intake form (confidential), 3) offer noise-reducing headphones and flexible late-starts on symptom days, 4) 4-week check-in with Sasha and Dana. do we have consensus?

Riley: consensus from me. happy to trade desks temporarily if needed.

Sasha: appreciate it. headphones would be helpful. i won't post medical details here — i'll reply to the intake DM.

Dana (Manager): marked Sasha exempt from rotation through 2026-06-15 and submitted hold request for 2W-07. let me know if you want help moving monitors etc.

Facilities Bot: Action: hold placed on desk 2W-07 for Sasha by Dana (Manager) until 2026-06-15.

Morgan (People Ops): follow-up: i'll create the confidential accommodation file and send the intake DM now. we'll treat this as a reasonable accommodation; documentation optional at start. scheduling a 4-week check-in with Sasha & Dana. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Sasha: thank you so much — already breathing easier. :relieved:
